guarantees.claim: Instance u_prim_buf_out connects out_buf to out via prim_buf with width NumOutBufBits.

assumptions.claim: NumOutBufBits matches the bit width of the out signal and is properly sized for the data path.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch would cause elaboration error; if ignored, data truncation or padding occurs.

assumptions.claim: The prim_buf module implements a combinational or appropriately clocked buffer that passes in_i to out_o without latency (or with acceptable latency).
assumptions.risk: If prim_buf requires a clock or enable signal not connected, out_buf may be undriven or stale.

uncertain_points.claim: prim_buf definition (missing clk/rst/en connections) must be checked to ensure intended data propagation behavior.
uncertain_points.cond: out changes while downstream logic samples out_buf
uncertain_points.risk: If prim_buf is synchronous but unclocked, out_buf may not update, causing AES output data to be incorrect or stale.

uncertain_points.claim: Other ports of prim_buf (e.g., en_i, ready_o) are not connected; verify they are not necessary for operation.
uncertain_points.risk: Unused input ports may float or default to an invalid state, affecting buffer behavior.
